ATF.settings.menuHint: Set two approved token appearances players can switch between.
ATF.settings.transitionHint: Visual effect played on the token when it switches between its two images. Fade is Foundry's default.
ATF.hud.outOfSync: Current art matches neither form — click to choose
ATF.hud.outOfSyncGm: Current art matches neither form — click to assign it
ATF.hud.noGM: No Game Master online — switching unavailable
ATF.config.hint: Configure two approved token images per character. Only players who own the character can switch, and only between the images you set here.
ATF.config.hintTokenizer: Tokenizer is active. Tokenize each appearance separately so Normal and Armored do not share one file. For Dynamic ring subject, use Tokenizer's Apply Dynamic preset (a baked circular frame double-frames under Foundry rings).
ATF.config.tokenizeTooltip: Open Tokenizer for this appearance. Saves a token into this slot; the character portrait is not changed.
ATF.config.tokenizeTooltipEmpty: No image yet — add or paste art in Tokenizer. Portrait is not changed.
ATF.config.noActors: No player-owned characters found. Assign a character to a player, then reopen this window.
ATF.dialog.outOfSyncContent: This token's current artwork does not match either configured appearance. Which one should it become?
ATF.dialog.adoptContent: This art isn't assigned to either appearance. Use it as one of the two approved forms. The token stays as it is.
ATF.notify.tokenizerNoop: Tokenizer did not produce a new token image.
ATF.notify.tokenizerSavedHidden: {label} token saved. It is used when the token switches.
ATF.errors.imagesMustDiffer: Image A and Image B must be different.
ATF.errors.notEnabled: Appearance switching is not enabled for this character.
ATF.errors.notOwner: You do not own this character.
ATF.errors.expired: The switch request expired. Please try again.
ATF.errors.noImage: The selected appearance has no image.
ATF.errors.syncFailed: Could not switch appearance. The previous artwork was restored.
ATF.errors.tokenizerOpen: Tokenizer is already open. Finish or close it first.
